correctness.rationale: For area-uniform Y inside a nondegenerate triangle, the prior polygonal normal convention counts twice the number of relative-interior edge projection feet for generic Y; thus N=4 or 6. In an obtuse triangle, only the two strips at the obtuse vertex are restrictive. Their intersections with the opposite side form an interval with exactly F(A,b/c)=bc sin²A/[(c-b cos A)(b-c cos A)]=(1-k²)/(1+k²+k(q+q^{-1})), k=-cos A>0, q=b/c. This proves the complete two-point law. AM-GM proves fixed-A unique maximizer b=c, F*=cot²(A/2), while expanding q+q^-1 gives exact sinh² stability. For k→0 and k(q+q^-1)→λ in [0,∞], the exact fraction tends 1/(1+λ), so all mean limits from 4 through 6 occur with allowed degenerating q. Independently checked 35 exact stability values, 20 geometric subsegment endpoint fractions, and exact rational F=32/133. Source establishes the qualitative generic critical point classification; independent algebra proves the quantitative formula.
